title: Principal Trait Analysis: Towards Deriving "Skills" in Human-AI Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2608.11460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model-powered agents are increasingly used in the workplace via human-artificial intelligence (AI) collaboration. In this new era of work, it is important to understand the kinds of prompting traits that contribute to task success. Moreover, we need to uncover key skills required for modern professionals and inform educators on how to foster these skills among students. Existing guidelines for human-AI collaboration are built from either top-down theory or context-specific observations of human-AI interactions. However, since LLM capabilities are rapidly improving, theory may not be able to explain emerging interaction patterns, and empirical guidelines may become obsolete quickly. In this work, we explore an automated, data-driven approach to uncover patterns, which we term traits, of effective human-AI interaction that are aligned with task outcomes. translated_title: 主体特质分析：迈向人机协作中的“技能”提取
translated_abstract: 基于大型语言模型的智能体正越来越多地通过人机协作方式应用于工作场所。在这个工作新时代，理解哪些提示特质有助于任务成功至关重要。此外，我们需要揭示现代专业人员所需的关键技能，并告知教育工作者如何在学生中培养这些技能。现有人机协作指南要么基于自上而下的理论构建，要么基于对人机交互的特定情境观察。然而，由于大型语言模型能力快速提升，理论可能无法解释新兴的交互模式，经验性指南也可能迅速过时。在本研究中，我们探索了一种自动化的、数据驱动的方法来揭示模式，我们称之为有效人机交互的特质，这些特质与任务结果对齐。我们提出了主体特质分析，一种基于主成分分析的...
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“主体特质分析”的数据驱动方法，利用主成分分析自动识别与任务结果对齐的有效人机交互特质，以提取现代专业人员所需的关键技能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Principal Trait Analysis," a data-driven method using PCA to automatically identify effective human-AI interaction traits aligned with task outcomes, aiming to derive key skills for modern professionals.
